In detail

The 2022 police breakdown grouped Prądnik Czerwony with neighbouring Prądnik Biały as the pairing with the city's highest recorded sexual-offence count (8) and highest vehicle-theft count (19) of any district grouping that year. The 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey rated it 3.68/5, a middling score, with no specific incident pattern beyond the police figures above. No 2025-2026 dated news coverage specific to this district was found beyond the routine city-wide trend (crime falling citywide, see the Kraków-wide note in the methodology). Sources checked: Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
